corrections.text: The article states that "the ESP32-C3 and ESP32-S3 gained Bluetooth support alongside WiFi support 'thanks to the espradio package'" in TinyGo 0.42. TinyGo's own 0.42 release notes attribute the espradio-based WiFi addition to the original ESP32, not ESP32-C3/S3, and InfoQ's independent coverage states that WiFi and Bluetooth networking for ESP32-C3 and ESP32-S3 via the espradio library shipped in the TinyGo 0.41 release. Only Bluetooth support for ESP32-C3/S3 is new in 0.42.
